items.title: Elegant Botanical Vines and Floral Silhouette Design for CNC Art
items.description: A refreshing biophilic silhouette design that breaks away from abstract geometry to feature fluid botanical vines and detailed blooming flowers. This scenic, nature-inspired vector file is available in scalable DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, optimized for clean cuts without fragile points. Perfect for manufacturing custom artistic metal garden gates, residential privacy fences, and decorative laser-cut wall murals for restaurants or cozy patios.

items.title: Industrial Minimalist Triangle Mesh Perforated Screen File for Laser Cut
items.description: A clean, functional industrial vector file featuring a highly precise repeating triangular mesh grid. This dense perforated layout is engineered in DXF, SVG, and DWG formats for flawless high-volume laser cutting, punch pressing, and CNC metal perforation. Perfectly suited for manufacturing architectural sunshades, HVAC radiator covers, ventilation grilles, and modern acoustic panels.

items.title: Abstract Radial Swirl DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Screens
items.description: Free to use, this design has interlocking radial swirl bands cross the panel in four large arcs, with a small cluster of curled insect-leg-like accents adding an unexpected organic detail near the center. The bold, almost op-art swirl motion gives this piece a strong contemporary edge.
